set.body: Follow-up from the typed-lucidity pass. Audit scalar wrappers whose public constructors still accept non-finite or semantically invalid values, beginning with Length and MeasureDistance. Decide whether positivity belongs in the scalar itself or only in consuming structures such as Perspective, then encode that ownership explicitly. Keep ergonomic unit constructors, provide operand-rich errors, and add compile-time/runtime boundary tests without forcing validation into numeric inner loops.
set.title: Close scalar-wrapper construction gaps
